data.narrative:
Primoco UAV is a publicly traded defense and security company founded by Ladislav Semetkovský. The valuation universe comprises 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Evolv Technology, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI, drawn from a broader population of 26 same-sector entities.

The peer-median method is not applicable in this instance. Despite identifying 26 companies operating within the Defense & Security sector, the narrow filtering criteria—same development stage, adjacent stage, and similar valuation tier—yielded insufficient datapoints to support a robust median calculation. Specifically, only 1 same-stage peer was identified, with 0 adjacent-stage and 0 similar-tier comparables, falling short of the minimum 3-datapoint threshold required for statistical reliability. Applying an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable heterogeneity and bias.

No triangulated valuation range can be derived from the available data. The small public comparables set (2 companies) and the absence of narrowly filtered peer clusters preclude conventional multiples-based approaches. Additional methodologies—including DCF, revenue multiple analysis, or transaction comps—would be required to support a credible valuation range. Key uncertainties include the pricing multiples applicable to early-stage defense technology companies and the relevance of the identified public peers to Primoco's specific business model and scale.
